non_dependency_updates.name: Incremental customer upsert
non_dependency_updates.details: Merge cleaned rows into the curated customer table keyed on customer_id + effective_date, with updated_at tracking and soft-delete handling. Done when a re-run is a no-op and a changed record updates exactly one row.

non_dependency_updates.name: Log aggregation rollups
non_dependency_updates.details: Build per-minute and per-hour rollups: request count, error count/rate by service and level, and latency percentiles. Write to aggregate tables partitioned by day. Done when rollup numbers reconcile with a hand-counted sample of raw events.

non_dependency_updates.name: Design warehouse schema
non_dependency_updates.details: Define layers (raw/staging/curated), fact and dimension tables for customer and log metrics, the grain of each fact, surrogate keys and naming conventions. Include a simple ER diagram. Done when every KPI from M1 maps to a column and table.

non_dependency_updates.name: Component library scaffolding
non_dependency_updates.details: Create the component package: TypeScript config, build setup, folder structure, lint rules, and one trivial component to prove the pipeline. Done when the package builds and its test passes in CI.
